recorder.title: Record and transcribe
recorder.permDeniedHelp: Click the lock icon in the address bar → Microphone → Allow, then re-check
recorder.twoPhaseNotice: Live captions use a fast model. When you stop, a more accurate model re-listens automatically.
recorder.rerunHint: What you see now is a draft from the fast model. You can edit already — your edits will not be overwritten.
recorder.replaced: Updated {{updated}} segments · kept your {{preserved}} edited segments
recorder.twoPhaseNoticeWithEta: Live captions use a fast model. When you stop, a more accurate model re-listens automatically — about {{eta}}.
recorder.rerunningWithEta: Re-transcribing with {{model}} for better accuracy — about {{eta}} left…
recorder.replacedNoCounterpart: {{count}} of them had no matching new result and were kept as-is.
recorder.mergeByTimeNote: Merging aligns by timeline, not by segment index — the two models segment speech differently.
recorder.paraformerNotice: Chinese uses Paraformer by default — about 43 seconds for an hour of audio.
recorder.paraformerTradeoff: Trade-off: no word-level timestamps (captions highlight per sentence, not per word), numbers are spelled out, and English comes out lowercase.
recorder.turboTradeoff: large-v3-turbo gives word-level timestamps, digits and better proper nouns — at about 22 minutes per hour of audio.
recorder.wordLevelUnavailable: This engine has no word-level timestamps — captions highlight per sentence
recorder.insecureTitle: Recording is unavailable at this address
recorder.insecureHelp: Browsers only expose the microphone in a secure context (https:// or localhost). At an http://<IP> address `navigator.mediaDevices` does not exist — this is not browser-specific, switching browsers will not help.
recorder.insecureAlternative: Everything else works here: import a local media file or a link from the Capture page — transcription, summary and mindmap are unaffected.

dataDir.title: Data location
dataDir.moveExisting: Move existing data there as well
dataDir.safeToDelete: Deleting this directory will not break the app — it is recreated on next launch (your notes and downloaded models are lost, though).
dataDir.unsupported: This daemon does not expose an endpoint to change the data directory yet; shown read-only.
dataDir.sizeScopeNote: These figures cover the **models directory** and its volume. The notes database and imported media are not included yet — the daemon has no whole-directory size endpoint, and a misleading total is worse than an incomplete one.
dataDir.perDirNote: The daemon reports the total for the whole data directory only; it does not yet measure each sub-directory. Purposes are listed below without sizes rather than showing a guessed number.

proxy.title: Network proxy

modeHint.off: All requests go direct. On mainland-China networks Hugging Face and GitHub are usually unreachable, so model downloads will fail.
modeHint.system: Reads HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / ALL_PROXY / NO_PROXY from the environment. With none set this behaves exactly like a direct connection, which is why it is the default.
modeHint.manual: Use the addresses below. All three accept credentials embedded in the URL.

proxy.authHint: For authentication, embed it in the URL: http://user:pass@127.0.0.1:7890
proxy.loopbackAlwaysBypassed: Loopback addresses (localhost / 127.x / .local) always bypass the proxy — a locally hosted LLM behind a remote proxy could never work.
proxy.socksFfmpegTitle: With SOCKS, media streaming goes direct
proxy.socksFfmpegDetail: ffmpeg does not support SOCKS (libavformat only reads http_proxy), so fetching and transcoding remote media bypasses the proxy. Link resolution and downloading use yt-dlp, which does support SOCKS and will go through it. To route everything through the proxy, use an HTTP/HTTPS proxy instead.
proxy.unsupported: This daemon does not expose a proxy settings endpoint yet
proxy.unsupportedDetail: You can fill the form in, but saving will fail — it will not pretend to succeed. It will work unchanged once the endpoint ships. Until then, start the daemon with HTTPS_PROXY set.
proxy.verdictProxyDown: The proxy itself is unreachable — check the address, port, and that your client is running.
proxy.verdictAllOk: Proxy works, and every target was reachable.
proxy.verdictUpstreamBlocked: The proxy works, but some targets were unreachable — the problem is the target or its route, not your proxy.
proxy.testUsesSaved: ⚠️ You have unsaved changes. Tests run against the SAVED configuration — save first, or you are reading a stale result.

purposes.title: Per-purpose models
purposes.intro: Chat, summary+mindmap, and translation can each use a different model. Fields left blank inherit the global configuration above. Summary and mindmap share one slot — both are "read the whole text, emit structure".

hints.translate: Wants cheap and fast — the cost gap shows up at volume.

purposes.incomplete: ⚠️ Incomplete: both a provider and a model must resolve, otherwise this feature is treated as "no LLM configured".
purposes.noDefault: No default provider/model is configured above. Fields left blank here have nothing to inherit.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.probeCaveat: This page checks whether components are loaded. The stronger "does the feature actually work" self-check (e.g. whether a Chinese word matches in FTS5) currently exists only as the CLI scripts/selfcheck.mjs with no HTTP endpoint, so no feature-level verdict is shown here. A green light does not guarantee the feature works.
diagnostics.daemonDownHint: The OpenMemo local service is not running, or the port changed.
diagnostics.tokenizerFallback: not enabled, fell back to {{tokenizer}}; Chinese search may be inaccurate

asr.languageInvalid: Invalid language code (expected zh, en, yue, zh-Hans …, or auto). The backend will silently fall back to auto.
asr.autoHint: Auto-detect will not use Paraformer (the backend picks an engine from the language prefix). Choosing Chinese explicitly is faster and more accurate for Chinese audio.

secureContext.title: This address is not a secure context — some features are unavailable
secureContext.localhostCaveat: Open http://127.0.0.1:10000 instead (works if you are on the machine running OpenMemo). For remote access, browsers only expose the microphone over https or localhost — this is not browser-specific, switching browsers will not help. Everything else is unaffected.

caps.microphone: **Recording is unavailable** — browsers only expose the microphone in a secure context.
caps.webLocks: Cross-tab leader election is unavailable — each tab opens its own connection.
caps.clipboard: Copy buttons are unavailable — the clipboard API also requires a secure context.
caps.storage: Session storage is blocked — saving still works (the token is kept in memory), but each reload costs one extra handshake.

jobToast.doneRestartHint: Installed, but the local service must restart before it takes effect.
jobToast.blockedHint: Not a failure — it resumes automatically once the condition is met.
